name: focused-person-discovery
purpose: Manual supervised Codex acceptance cases for the focused skill merge; repository static checks do not execute Codex or prove real contacts.

cases.scenario: A source-supported, Arizona-feasible VP data-product job is in a CDO-led department; the manager's name is absent and some resume leadership years are unverified.
must: begin people research without a named manager
hold only unverified mandatory qualifications, not invent a second job
mustNot: reject solely because advertised work overlaps the CDO remit

cases.scenario: An exact employer ATS AI transformation posting states 'reports to CTO' but no recruiter or hiring manager is named.
must: report a named CTO as functionally plausible without assuming personal hiring authority

cases.scenario: Official research surfaces a CTO, CDO and operating VP first; a recruiting employee promoting the exact job is found fourth.
must: label recruiter as process entry rather than owner
return at most primary and one justified alternate
mustNot: claim public promoter has verified direct inbox

cases.scenario: Owner requests research on exactly two companies, while the orchestrator also contains general regional discovery guidance.
must: research the two named companies only
investigate the exact openings and role promoters

cases.scenario: A CDO has a named work email in last year's conference PDF, a current LinkedIn profile and a separate employer ATS application link.
must: keep ATS application distinct from person contact
mustNot: label historical address CURRENT_PERSON_WORK_ROUTE without new evidence
